entries.detail: First allocation attempt lacked STATA_MP_PATH; the next attempt refused the existing failed directory. Those local directories were preserved and the environment corrected. No command measurement resulted.

A blanket zero-allocation assertion failed on weak_d3: baseline 21, allocation-only 5 events. Exact science and stable live/peak memory passed. The harness now requires zero only for fast one-FE profiles and records remaining routes without claiming their whole-iteration certificate. Low-memory one-FE independently passed 16 to 0. The original prospective protocol is unchanged and this exception limits its adoption claim.

Allocation-only low FW initially 0.878 to 0.963 seconds (+9.7%). Two independently seeded, reversed-order repeats gave 0.733 to 0.735 and 0.775 to 0.734 seconds. The initial pair remains in the archive.

The unchanged main generator rejects N65536 as a singleton. Kept that rule; performance controls use N65535 and N65537. The independent balanced-dummy oracle exercises exactly N65536. No estimator result was produced for the rejected generated input.
